# shapes_probes.txt - R2D-SHAPES S6 (D-W8-1083): the 62 probes of the example shapes, read on both systems (the Linux
# capture in the protocol and the two Windows captures). Format: tests/tools/image_probe.py ("<x> <y> <RRGGBBAA>
# [<tol>]", origin top-left, alpha included). Fixed BEFORE the data existed (GODS_LAWS.md L-43): every value comes
# from the geometry of the scene and the sRGB formula, never from a capture. No probe lies within 2 pixels of a curved
# or a slanted edge, so none depends on how a curve is cut into segments. The scene is in the header comment of
# examples/shapes/shapes.cpp.
#
# the background: the four corners and a point between the pieces; 0.2 encoded by the CPU = 124 = 0x7C

#  not a public promise, so each value is the middle of the two answers (blend the sRGB-encoded colours, or blend the
#  linear light and encode) and the tolerance covers both, plus 2
